column1: # The cd32-probe row map, with Copperline's column.
# WHAT THIS IS FOR. A real CD32 running Copperline's tools/cd32-probe displays
# 30 measurement rows on screen as hex. Photograph the screen, mount the SAME
# ISO on our core with scripts/cd32-probe.sh, and the three columns -- real
# hardware, Copperline, us -- line up row for row.
# WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN THE REST. Rows 14-23 are CD seek and read costs:
# Akiko's behaviour, which is this core's speciality and the one area where no
# test suite exists at all. Copperline's own HARDWARE-RIG-PLAN.md lists
# akiko-sector-slot-order-no-ground-truth as an open item. A photograph of these
# rows on a real CD32 would be the first measurement either project has.
# Rows 24-29 are bus-cycle costs against the CIA E-clock -- unmapped, ROM and
# chip reads and writes -- which bear on the memory_router and ddram paths.
# THE COPPERLINE COLUMN IS NOT GROUND TRUTH. It is what one emulator predicts.
# Where a row is written "~139 ms" rather than as hex, Copperline's README gives
# it as an approximation, so treat the hex rows as the comparable ones and the
# rest as order-of-magnitude.
# Source: tools/cd32-probe/README.md in CopperlineHQ/Copperline @ e868a66.
# Copperline's values are for the FULL variant (probe track 1 plus the game's
# audio tracks). The data-only padded variant answers rows 15-23 across the full
# seek stroke instead, and its layout rows describe the early-boot path -- that
# is expected, not a disagreement.
# row

column4: FindTask(NULL): the boot CLI process address. Its low word decides the game's buggy freeanim version check (signed <= 40 passes)
OpenLibrary(freeanim, version = CLITASK): the game's exact call. Nonzero here on real hardware = the game's bug passes there
OldOpenLibrary(freeanim), only tried if BUGOPEN failed
E-ticks at probe entry since power-on (/EFREQ = seconds)
min E-ticks, 1-sector read at +500 after repositioning to LBA 1000
.. +10000 (data only on the padded disc; times out on full)
CD_PLAYLSN 1 s of audio at LBA 11000, DoIO duration: value - 1 s = locate cost (audio discs only; errors on the padded disc)
E-ticks for 64 sequential sectors at LBA 1201 (as CDInit configured: 2x = 150/s)
65536x `MOVE.W D2,(A4)+` over $A80000 (unmapped write -- currently billed free in Copperline)
